The Great Barrier Reef, stretching over 2,300 kilometers off the northeastern coast of Australia, is the world's largest coral reef system. It is composed of thousands of individual reefs and hundreds of islands, housing an extraordinarily diverse ecosystem that includes thousands of marine species. However, over the past few decades, the reef has suffered unprecedented damage due to rising ocean temperatures driven by climate change. When water temperatures remain elevated for extended periods, corals expel the symbiotic algae living in their tissues, causing the coral to turn completely white—a phenomenon known as coral bleaching. While bleached corals are not dead, they are under severe stress and highly vulnerable to mortality if conditions do not normalize. Conservationists argue that urgent global reductions in carbon emissions, alongside localized protection measures, are required to prevent catastrophic ecosystem collapse.

According to the text, coral bleaching occurs when ----.

options.A: ocean waters become polluted with industrial chemical waste
options.B: water temperatures remain high, causing corals to lose symbiotic algae
options.C: invasive marine species feed on fragile coral tissues
options.D: marine tourism damages the structural foundation of individual reefs
options.E: extreme ocean currents wash away essential nutrient deposits

The development of electric vehicles (EVs) represents a major milestone in the transition toward sustainable transportation. Unlike conventional internal combustion engine vehicles, EVs produce zero tailpipe emissions, significantly reducing urban air pollution and greenhouse gas emissions. However, the widespread adoption of EVs presents several challenges. The manufacturing of lithium-ion batteries requires the extraction of rare metals such as cobalt and lithium, an industry often associated with environmental degradation and human rights concerns in mining regions. Furthermore, the environmental benefit of EVs depends heavily on the source of the electricity used to charge them; if power grids rely on coal-fired plants, the net reduction in carbon emissions is minimized. Therefore, achieving truly clean mobility requires both sustainable battery supply chains and a transition toward renewable power generation.

options.A: eliminating tailpipe emissions and reducing air pollution
options.B: requiring fewer natural resources during manufacturing
options.C: operating without any reliance on local electrical grids
options.D: lowering the cost of public transportation systems
options.E: generating renewable electricity while in motion

reading.question_text:
Deep-sea hydrothermal vents, discovered in the late 1970s, changed our understanding of life on Earth. Located thousands of meters below the ocean surface along tectonic plate boundaries, these volcanic vents spew superheated, mineral-rich fluid into pitch-black waters. Despite the extreme pressure, toxicity, and complete absence of sunlight, vibrant ecosystems flourish around these vents. Instead of relying on photosynthesis, the food chain here is supported by chemosynthetic bacteria. These microorganisms convert chemical compounds, such as hydrogen sulfide, into organic energy, sustaining specialized creatures like giant tube worms, blind shrimp, and unique crabs. Scientists believe studying these extremophiles could shed light on how life originated on early Earth and whether life could exist in sub-surface oceans on extraterrestrial bodies like Jupiter's moon, Europa.

How do ecosystems near hydrothermal vents survive without sunlight?

options.A: They absorb thermal radiation emitted by underwater volcanoes.
options.B: They rely on chemosynthetic bacteria converting chemicals into energy.
options.C: They consume organic matter floating down from the ocean surface.
options.D: They store energy captured during rare shallow-water migrations.
options.E: They utilize artificial light sources brought by deep-sea submersibles.

Sleep is a fundamental biological necessity, yet modern lifestyle factors have led to a global sleep deprivation epidemic. Chronic sleep deficiency is linked to severe health issues, including cardiovascular disease, obesity, weakened immune function, and impaired cognitive performance. During sleep, particularly deep REM stages, the brain undergoes crucial maintenance: consolidating memories, clearing toxic metabolic waste products, and repairing cellular tissue. Despite clear scientific evidence regarding its importance, many individuals sacrifice sleep for work or digital entertainment. Health organizations stress that adults should aim for 7 to 9 hours of quality sleep per night, emphasizing that consistent sleep hygiene is as vital to long-term health as balanced nutrition and regular physical exercise.

options.A: shuts down cognitive processing entirely to conserve body heat
options.B: consolidates memories and clears toxic metabolic waste products
options.C: produces high levels of adrenaline to stimulate muscular repair
options.D: increases physical activity while decreasing cellular recovery rates
options.E: prevents the immune system from releasing protective antibodies

reading.question_text:
The Rosetta Stone, discovered by French soldiers in Egypt in 1799, is one of the most important archaeological artifacts in history. The stone slab contains a royal decree issued in 196 BC carved in three distinct scripts: Ancient Egyptian hieroglyphs, Demotic script, and Ancient Greek. Because scholars were already familiar with Ancient Greek, the stone provided the long-sought key to deciphering hieroglyphs, which had been unreadable for over a millennium. British polymath Thomas Young and French linguist Jean-François Champollion led the groundbreaking decipherment efforts. Champollion ultimately cracked the code in 1822 by realizing that hieroglyphs represented both phonetic sounds and symbolic ideas. This monumental breakthrough opened up centuries of recorded Egyptian history to modern scholars.

Why was the Rosetta Stone crucial for deciphering Egyptian hieroglyphs?

options.A: It contained a dictionary translating hieroglyphic symbols into Latin.
options.B: It featured the same decree written in Ancient Greek alongside hieroglyphs.
options.C: It was the only ancient Egyptian artifact surviving undamaged.
options.D: It proved that hieroglyphs were purely picture-based, non-phonetic symbols.
options.E: It was written directly by French linguist Jean-François Champollion.

options.A: Solar energy is becoming the main power source for household electricity.

options.B: Solar panels generate more energy on cloudy winter days than in summer.
options.C: Fossil fuel power plants can be turned on and off within seconds.
options.D: Electricity prices are regulated by national regulatory commissions.

dialogue.question_text:
Grace: Do you think remote medical consultations will remain popular after the pandemic?

options.C: Rural health clinics are being closed down due to lack of medical staff.
options.D: Health insurance companies refuse to cover online doctor consultations.
options.E: Internet connectivity in remote mountain villages is faster than in urban areas.

Oliver: The university library is replacing printed academic journals with digital subscriptions.
Zoe: That will save space, but won't it make old research harder to access for some students?
Oliver: ----

dialogue.question_text:
Ryan: I read that deforestation in rainforests is accelerating global climate change.
Jessica: Yes, trees absorb massive amounts of carbon dioxide, so cutting them down releases stored carbon.
Ryan: ----
Jessica: Precisely. Protecting rainforests is essential for regulating global climate patterns.

options.A: Planting urban parks can fully replace the biodiversity of tropical rainforests.
options.B: So forests act as critical carbon sinks that keep greenhouse gas levels in check?
options.C: Timber export is the main source of income for many developing nations.
options.D: Wildfires are primarily caused by lightning strikes in dry coniferous forests.
options.E: Rain levels in tropical zones have reached record highs in recent decades.

dialogue.question_text:
Chloe: Should we book our flight tickets now or wait for a price drop next month?
Liam: Flight prices usually rise as the departure date approaches, especially during peak season.

Liam: Good idea. Securing them early will also give us better seat selection options.

options.A: Then we had better buy them today before prices increase further.
options.B: Let's wait until the day before departure to get last-minute discounts.
options.C: Airline companies rarely change ticket prices once schedules are published.
options.D: Travelling by train is much more scenic than flying across the continent.

dialogue.question_text:
Selin: Plastik atıkların okyanuslara karışmasını engellemek için geri dönüşüm yeterli mi?

Arda: Kesinlikle. Asıl çözüm tek kullanımlık plastik üretimini kaynağında sınırlandırmaktır.

dialogue.question_text:
Can: Bilim insanları neden Mars'ta geçmişte su bulunup bulunmadığını bu kadar çok araştırıyor?
Deniz: Çünkü suyun varlığı, kızıl gezegende bir zamanlar mikrobiyal yaşamın var olmuş olabileceğini gösterir.
Can: ----
Deniz: Aynen öyle. Yaşam izi arayışında su her zaman en temel ipucudur.

options.A: Mars yüzeyinde sıcaklık geceleri eksi yüz derecenin altına düşüyor.
options.B: Yani su aramak aslında geçmişteki olası bir yaşamın ayak izlerini takip etmektir.

options.D: Gelecekte Mars'a insanlı koloniler kurulması hedefleniyor.
options.E: Atmosferdeki karbondioksit oranı oksijen üretimi için dönüştürülebilir.

restatement.question_text: Although the initial cost of installing solar panels is high, homeowners save money in the long run through reduced electricity bills.

options.A: Installing solar panels costs a lot initially, but it eventually leads to financial savings for homeowners by lowering energy bills.
options.B: Homeowners who install solar panels immediately recover their expenses due to massive drops in electricity prices.
options.C: Despite low installation costs, solar panels do not save homeowners money unless electricity bills increase significantly.
options.D: High electricity bills force many homeowners to invest in solar panels, even though long-term savings are minimal.
options.E: Lowering electricity bills requires a high initial investment in solar panel technology that rarely pays off for homeowners.

restatement.question_text: Had the medical research team received adequate funding, they could have completed the clinical trials much earlier.

options.A: The medical research team completed the clinical trials early because they were granted excessive financial funding.
options.B: The clinical trials were delayed because the medical research team lacked sufficient financial resources.
options.C: Unless the medical research team receives more funding, the clinical trials will take a very long time to finish.
options.D: Even with sufficient funding, the medical research team was unable to accelerate the pace of their clinical trials.
options.E: Adequate funding was provided to the medical research team, allowing them to complete trials ahead of schedule.

restatement.question_text: Few inventions in human history have had as profound an impact on communication as the mobile smartphone.

options.A: Mobile smartphones have transformed human communication more significantly than almost any other invention in history.
options.B: The mobile smartphone is one of several historical inventions that had very little effect on global communication.

options.E: No historical invention except the mobile smartphone has ever brought about changes in human communication.

restatement.question_text: So heavy was the snowstorm in the mountain pass that rescue teams had to postpone their search operations.

restatement.question_text: Hardly had the keynote speaker finished her presentation when the audience erupted into enthusiastic applause.

restatement.question_text: No sooner had the new regulation been announced than shopkeepers started protesting against its strict requirements.

options.A: Shopkeepers had been protesting against strict regulations long before the new policy was official.

options.B: Before the late 19th century, scientists did not completely grasp that infectious diseases were caused by microbes.
options.C: In the late 19th century, infectious diseases ceased to be a threat because scientists eliminated harmful microbes.

restatement.question_text: Without clean water sanitation systems, infectious diseases spread rapidly throughout overcrowded urban refugee camps.

options.A: Infectious diseases in urban refugee camps are easily contained even when water sanitation systems fail.

options.A: She failed the flight simulator test because her intensive training lasted for only a few months.

options.A: As the use of artificial intelligence technologies in medicine increases, a significant decrease in diagnostic errors is observed.

situation.question_text: You are working on a group project with classmates, but one team member consistently misses deadlines and fails to complete assigned tasks. You want to address the issue politely but firmly without creating unnecessary conflict. What do you say?

options.A: You are ruining our project grade, and I am going to report you to the professor immediately!
options.B: We noticed you've been struggling with deadlines; let's discuss how we can help you catch up so we finish on time.
options.C: Don't worry about the project at all; I will do all your work for you so you can rest.
options.D: Group projects are completely useless because there is always someone who does nothing.
options.E: Why haven't you attended any meetings? Nobody wants to work with you anymore.

options.A: Hiking is exhausting and boring, so I definitely don't want to come with you.
options.B: I'd love to join, but I have a major exam on Monday that requires my full attention. Let's plan another trip soon!
options.C: Sure, I will come hiking with you! Exams aren't that important anyway.
options.D: You should cancel the hiking trip too and stay home to study for your exams.
options.E: Why do you always invite me on trips when you know I am busy with academic work?

situation.question_text: You ordered a specific book online, but when the package arrives, you open it and discover a completely different book inside. You call customer service to request a replacement. What do you say?

options.A: Your company is incompetent, and I demand an immediate cash refund for this terrible service!
options.B: I received my package today, but it contains a different item than what I ordered. Could you please send the correct book?
options.C: I am calling to tell you that I really enjoyed reading the book you sent me by mistake.
options.D: Can you tell me when the next discount sale on academic books will begin?
options.E: I forgot which book I ordered, so could you check my online purchase history?

situation.question_text: You are attending an academic seminar, and the speaker makes a statement that directly contradicts data you recently read in an authoritative journal. You want to ask a polite clarifying question during Q&A. What do you say?

options.A: Your presentation is completely wrong because recent studies prove the exact opposite of what you claimed!
options.B: Thank you for the talk. According to a recent study in Journal X, data suggests Y. Could you elaborate on how your findings align with that?
options.C: I don't think you are qualified to speak on this subject given the mistakes in your slides.
options.D: Why did you choose such a boring topic for today's university seminar presentation?
options.E: Could you please speak louder because people in the back row cannot hear you clearly?

situation.question_text: Your neighbor plays very loud music late at night, preventing you from sleeping before an early morning work meeting. You knock on their door to ask them to turn down the volume tactfully. What do you say?

options.A: Turn off that noise right now or I am calling the police immediately!
options.B: Hi! I have a very early meeting tomorrow and am struggling to sleep. Would you mind turning the volume down a bit?
options.C: Your music taste is terrible, and everyone in the building is complaining about you.
options.D: Could you turn up the volume a little? I really like the song you are playing right now.
options.E: I am moving out of this apartment building tomorrow because of your loud music.

situation.question_text: You are at a job interview and the interviewer asks if you have experience managing unexpected crisis situations in your previous workplace. You want to answer confidently with an example. What do you say?

options.A: I have never faced any problems or crises in my career because everything always goes perfectly.
options.B: Yes, in my previous role, when a server went down, I coordinated with tech support to restore systems within an hour.
options.C: Crises are stressful, so I usually prefer to leave the office when unexpected problems arise.
options.D: I don't think crisis management is relevant for the job position I am applying for today.
options.E: My previous supervisor handled all issues, so I never had to take responsibility for anything.

situation.question_text: A colleague asks to borrow your laptop for a presentation because theirs broke down suddenly. You need your laptop for an upcoming meeting in 30 minutes. You want to offer a helpful alternative. What do you say?

options.A: I can't help you at all; you should have taken better care of your computer equipment.
options.B: I need my laptop for a meeting in 30 minutes, but you can borrow my flash drive to load your slides on the conference room PC.
options.C: Sure, take my laptop for the rest of the day! My meeting isn't important anyway.
options.D: Why don't you cancel your presentation and reschedule it for next month?
options.E: Laptops break down all the time, so you should just present without any visual slides.

situation.question_text: You are staying at a hotel and notice that the air conditioner in your room is leaking water onto the carpet. You call the front desk to report the issue promptly. What do you say?

options.B: Hello, the air conditioner in Room 304 is leaking water onto the floor. Could you please send someone to inspect or fix it?
options.C: Is the hotel swimming pool open for guests during late evening hours?
options.D: The carpet in my room is very nice, but I think the room temperature is slightly too cold.

options.C: You should just pick the major that earns the most money regardless of whether you like it.
options.D: Why are you worrying about university when you still have months before applications open?
options.E: I picked my major in five minutes, so I don't understand why you are making a big deal out of it.

options.B: Based on our estimates, the current budget will cover initial phases, but we will need about 10% additional funding to finish.
options.C: Budgeting is not my responsibility, so you should ask the finance department instead.
options.D: We will double the project budget immediately without giving any financial justification.
options.E: If you don't give us unlimited funds, we will cancel the project right now.

options.B: Affedersiniz, sınava odaklanmaya çalışıyorum da sesinizi biraz alçaltmanız mümkün mü acaba?
options.C: Kütüphaneler ders çalışmak için hiç uygun yerler değil zaten, ben gidiyorum.
options.D: Konuştuğunuz konu çok ilgi çekici, ben de sohbetinize katılabilir miyim?
options.E: Kütüphanede yüksek sesle konuşmak kanunen yasaktır, bilmiyor musunuz?

situation.question_text: A passenger on a train asks if the seat next to you is occupied. It is free because your friend got off at the previous station. You reply welcomingly. What do you say?

options.A: Yes, someone is sitting here, so please find another seat elsewhere in the carriage.
options.B: No, it's completely free now. Please, feel free to sit down!
options.C: I put my heavy luggage on that seat, so you cannot sit there.
options.D: Train tickets are very expensive these days, aren't they?
options.E: The train is running thirty minutes behind schedule today.

situation.question_text: You are dining at a restaurant and notice that your food is lukewarm when it should be served hot. You inform the waiter politely. What do you say?

options.A: This food is completely inedible! I am leaving without paying a single cent.
options.B: Excuse me, my meal seems to have cooled down. Would you mind heating it up or bringing a fresh plate?
options.C: The decor in this restaurant is lovely, but the waiter service is very slow.
options.D: Could you bring me the dessert menu as soon as possible?
options.E: I didn't like the ingredients used in this soup, so please change the recipe.

situation.question_text: Your friend asks for your opinion on a jacket they just bought. You think the style doesn't suit them, but you want to give constructive criticism without hurting their feelings. What do you say?

options.A: That jacket looks terrible on you; you should throw it in the trash immediately!
options.B: It's a nice jacket, but I think the blue one you tried earlier suited your personal style much better.
options.C: I don't care about fashion at all, so why are you asking me?
options.D: You spent way too much money on clothes this month.
options.E: Everyone in the store was laughing at that jacket when you bought it.

situation.question_text: You are leading a workshop and run out of time before finishing your last few slides. You want to end the session professionally and share materials later. What do you say?

options.A: We ran out of time because you asked too many unnecessary questions during the talk.
options.B: Since our time is up, I will email the remaining slides and supplementary resources to all participants today.
options.C: I will stay here for another two hours until I finish every single slide in my presentation.
options.D: The remaining slides were not important anyway, so we can just skip them completely.
options.E: Please turn off the projector and exit the room immediately as the session is over.

situation.question_text: Your flight has been delayed by four hours, causing you to miss your connecting flight. You approach the airline desk to seek assistance calmly. What do you say?

options.A: You ruined my entire holiday trip and I am going to sue your airline company!
options.B: Hello, due to the four-hour delay, I missed my connecting flight. Could you help me rebook onto the next available flight?
options.C: Can you tell me what the weather forecast is like at my final destination?
options.D: I would like to buy an extra luggage allowance for my international flight.
options.E: Is there a comfortable lounge where I can wait for my original flight to board?

situation.question_text: You receive an email offering you a job position after an interview, but you have already accepted another offer. You want to decline professionally. What do you say?

options.A: I found a much better job with a higher salary, so I don't need your offer.
options.B: Thank you very much for the offer. However, I have recently accepted another position that aligns with my career goals. I wish you all the best.
options.C: Why did it take your HR department so long to send me this job offer email?
options.D: I accept the position and can start working at your office early next Monday morning.
options.E: Please send me more details about employee health insurance and holiday allowances.

situation.question_text: A colleague asks you to explain a complex software feature while you are rushing to an urgent meeting. You want to reschedule the explanation for later today. What do you say?

options.A: Figure it out yourself by reading the instruction manual on the company website!
options.B: I am rushing to an urgent meeting right now, but I can pop by your desk at 3 PM to walk you through it.
options.C: Software updates are very confusing for everyone in our department.
options.D: Sure, let's sit down right now for an hour and go through the software step by step.
options.E: I don't know how to use that software feature either, so ask someone else.

situation.question_text: You are returning a borrowed car to your friend and notice the fuel tank is almost empty. You fill up the tank before returning it and hand over the keys. What do you say?

options.A: Your car uses too much fuel, so you should consider buying a hybrid vehicle.
options.B: Thanks so much for lending me your car! I filled up the tank for you as a token of appreciation.
options.C: The fuel light was flashing when I drove, but I didn't have time to visit a petrol station.
options.D: Here are the keys, but I accidentally scratched the side mirror while parking.
options.E: I borrowed your car for three days because my own vehicle was at the mechanic shop.

situation.question_text: You are presenting at a university conference and your microphone suddenly stops working mid-sentence. You handle the technical glitch calmly with humor. What do you say?

options.A: Technology always fails! I refuse to continue speaking until someone replaces this equipment.
options.B: It seems technology wants me to test my projection voice today! Can everyone in the back still hear me clearly?
options.C: The sound technician in this venue is clearly not doing their job properly today.
options.D: I guess my presentation was so boring that even the microphone decided to go to sleep.
options.E: Please leave the auditorium while we spend forty minutes trying to repair the audio system.
